paragraphs.text: Muronia is a blighted land on the eastern side of North Aerona on Dominaria , succumbing to the cold embrace of a mysterious corruption.

The holy Muronian Order sends missionary dervishes with pamphlets to inform the world about the impending doom of the world on the day of Ragalka. They were known to damn sinners, lamenting their lack of faith and hope, promising that they would perish in horror and holocaust. Their habit includes a cowled cape.
During the Time of Troubles , Garth One-Eye used a Muronian dervish's habit and cowl to hide his identity.
Three Muronian dervishes were a part of Gull 's anti- wizard crusade a few years later.
